name: $k$-Mistake Littlestone Dimension / Littlestone Dimension
details: Every realizable branch is $k$-realizable for every $k\ge0$.
proof: A tree shattered in the ordinary realizable sense has every branch consistent with a hypothesis in the class, hence with zero disagreements. It is therefore $k$-realizable for every $k\ge0$, so $\mathrm L^{\mathrm{mist}}_k(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm L(\mathcal H)$.
proof_source: Immediate from the $k$-shattered-tree definition in Section 2.2.1 of \cite{filmus2023randomized}.
